text:
ana: heads-up: weve got the webinar + launch post on Thurs. need a tight smoke-run to validate the four headline numbers for the assets: p95/p99 token latency, coldstart heatmap, and long-context tail behavior for our quantized-n4 variant.

sam: copy. which region + artifacts?

ana: eu-west-1. artifacts: per-request CSV, heatmap PNG, 8 sample outputs per prompt, and a short manifest with model hash + seeds.

leo: want float16 baseline for delta? also how aggressive should coldstart induction be?

ana: yes baseline + quantized-n4. induce 3 coldstarts over the run. separate warmup bucket vs measurement. traffic: small smoke: 45 qps for 7 minutes.

maria: please include RNG seed(s) and a one-line methodology blurb I can paste into the blog. also tag dataset id on artifacts.

sam: plan: staging cluster, seeds 11,23,311, warmup 2m, measurement 7m, record token-level latencies + GPU util. will push to s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/1788889999-webinar-smoke/. include a reproducible command in the manifest.

ana: exclude KV dumps (size), include lightweight traces only.

benchbot: Scheduled job rb-1788889999 on staging for 2024-07-03T21:00:00Z. ETA artifacts ~30-50m after run.

leo: note: quantized-n4 benefits from slightly longer warmup. we'll do 120s warmup and restart two workers at minutes 3 and 5 for coldstarts.

sam: running now.

benchbot: rb-1788889999 COMPLETE. Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/1788889999-webinar-smoke/{manifest.json,latencies.csv,heatmap.png,samples.json}. Summary (measurement window): quantized-n4 p95=85ms p99=260ms; float16 baseline p95=68ms p99=195ms. first-token coldstart spike observed ~1.1s.

maria: grabbing artifacts and drafting blurb. quick flag: quantized-n4 p99 is ~33% higher vs internal float baseline under the short-warmup profile. will note in blog as short-warmup tail effect.

sam: quick diff vs last conservative run: quantized p99 up 5% when we run 5m warmup. if marketing wants a conservative number, we can rerun with 5m warmup but that will delay artifacts.

ana: annotate the blog: "numbers measured after 2m warmup; quantized variants can show larger tails under short warmup conditions". no rerun unless >20% delta.

leo: reproducible snippet for manifest (to include):
```
bench-run --model redwood/quantized-n4:rev-202407 --region eu-west-1 --qps 45 --duration 420s --warmup 120s --seeds 11,23,311 --out s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/1788889999-webinar-smoke/
```

ana: perfect, thanks team :sparkles:
